_meta.name: AlmiOET regulator enrichment — v2 (slug-aligned, grade-deferring)
_meta.supersedes: AlmiOET_regulator_dataset_v1.json — WRONG slugs + GUESSED grades. Replace v1 with this.
_meta.shape: Array under `regulators`, each with a real base `slug` (matches CC's DATA.regulators loader).
rules: BASE (organisations.json) OWNS grades. Entries here carry NO `grades` — the composer must read the grade from the base org record. Only `gradeFallback` supplies a grade, and ONLY where the base publishedGrade is empty (e.g. uk-hcpc), from a cited source.
v1 guessed grades that were WRONG (NZ nursing all-B, Oregon all-B, DHA all-B). Base has the real ones; removed here.
combiningRule null = no published combining rule = single sitting (composer already handles).
Per-entity `lastVerified` set so CC's currency gate can index the current ones; `verifyStatus:'confirm-official'` => renders but noindex + out of sitemap until the body's own page is re-read.
_meta.handoff_to_next_cc_session: CC's RegulatorEntity type/composer were built from v1 which carried `grades`. Make `grades` OPTIONAL and have the composer fall back to the BASE org grade when enrichment omits it. Then this v2 loads and defers to base correctly.
_meta.coverageNote: v2 = the REAL regulators people search (not the recruiters/NHS-trusts/universities that are most of the 610). Ongoing: more regulators + per-country batches to lift the ~163 near-miss orgs.

combiningRule.reducedWriting: Writing C (250) acceptable when combining, if the combined result reaches C+ Writing and B in the other three

regulators.registrationContext: The NMC's OET grades are the English-language condition for UK nurse and midwife registration, separate from the CBT and OSCE competence tests.

The GMC requires every sub-test at the required grade in a SINGLE sitting for doctors — no combining across sittings. After two years a reference letter attesting maintained English may substitute for re-testing.
The GPhC accepts OET as evidence of English for pharmacist registration in Great Britain.

The HCPC accepts OET (approved 2023) for internationally-educated allied health professionals — physiotherapists, radiographers, dietitians, occupational therapists, podiatrists and speech & language therapists.
The RCVS accepts OET as English evidence for overseas veterinary surgeons seeking UK registration.
NMBI is Ireland's nursing and midwifery regulator; OET is an accepted English route.
regulators.note: A 2024 source says NMBI lowered Writing to C+; the base scrape shows all-B. CONFLICT — held noindex until confirmed against NMBI.

regulators.registrationContext: The Dental Council of Ireland accepts OET for overseas dentists registering in Ireland.
Ireland's Medical Council accepts OET for medical registration; the base scrape carries no published grade — confirm the exact bar with the Council.
CORU regulates Ireland's health and social care professions (physiotherapists, dietitians, radiographers, occupational therapists, speech & language therapists); base carries no published grade.

combiningRule.reducedWriting: AHPRA permits combining two sittings within 12 months under its English-skills registration standard

regulators.registrationContext: AHPRA applies one English-language standard across its National Boards for all 12 recognised professions in Australia, reporting OET as numeric scores (350 = B).
The Australian Dental Council assesses overseas-trained dentists for Australian registration; OET is an accepted English route.
The Australian Pharmacy Council accepts OET for overseas pharmacists seeking Australian registration.
The Nursing Council of New Zealand accepts OET for internationally-qualified nurses seeking NZ registration.
The Medical Council of New Zealand accepts OET for international medical graduates as evidence of English.
The Dental Council of New Zealand accepts OET for overseas dentists.
The Pharmacy Council of New Zealand accepts OET for overseas pharmacists.
OET Medicine is recognised in the US pathway for international medical graduates via ECFMG certification.
TruMerit (formerly CGFNS) provides credential evaluation for internationally-educated nurses entering the US; OET is an accepted English test.
US nursing English requirements are set per state board and vary widely; Oregon's published bar is on the base record.
Florida's Board of Nursing sets one of the lower US bars; requirements vary state to state.
The College of Nurses of Ontario regulates nursing in Ontario; OET is accepted, with results assessed through the Canadian nursing pathway (NNAS).
The DHA licenses healthcare professionals in Dubai; its published OET bar is lower than most Western regulators.
The Department of Health – Abu Dhabi licenses healthcare professionals in the emirate of Abu Dhabi.
The Dubai Healthcare City Authority licenses practitioners within the DHCC free zone across all 12 professions.
The Singapore Medical Council accepts OET for doctors seeking registration in Singapore.
The Singapore Pharmacy Council accepts OET for overseas pharmacists.
The Singapore Dental Council accepts OET for overseas dentists.
The Health Professions Councils of Namibia (HPCNA) recognise OET across all 12 professions for practitioners registering in Namibia.
